svg.text: individual-based; each state summarises a host's lineages
Poisson rate, fixed count or single event
no intrinsic incubation: blood stage starts at inoculation, so hosts are not SEI
(constant N; a dead mosquito is replaced by a susceptible one)
λv: bites on I0 / IL with gametocytes
1 SLiM individual = 1 parasite genome; all ancestry kept in the tree sequence
k emerges from the mosquito’s composition
n ~ Geom(mean ν); one batch per bite,
split uniformly across the k genotypes
Simpson P_out is logged, not imposed
n ~ ZT Poisson(λ_ooc), NB if K > 0
Per oocyst: 2 gametes drawn independently & uniformly from the pool
selfing vs outcrossing emerges from the draw; P(i,j) ∝ pᵢpⱼ
each crossover swaps 2 chromatids; 2:2 at all loci
EIP (fixed 10 d); mosquito death removes all its broods
Interventions: vector control & seasonality scale biting (λh, λv, and ι); case-based blood-stage treatment → recovery; case-based radical cure & MDA → reservoir cleared (MDA also clears blood stage).
Genome: 14 PvP01 chromosomes as ONE linkage group, r = 0.5 at the 13 junctions (independent assortment), 7.4e-7/bp within chromosomes. Mutation rate is ZERO - the genome is a neutral scaffold and all
genetics come from the recorded genealogy; alleles are painted on downstream. Ground-truth IBD is read from the tree sequence, never inferred from markers.
